items.title: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to record high, Nvidia supplier unveils $75 billion shareholder return plan
items.author: Reuters
items.highlights: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold rise in quarterly operating profit to a record high on Wednesday, beating market forecasts, as continued demand for AI infrastructure drove up memory chip prices. The Nvidia supplier also said it will pursue shareholder returns totalling about 100 trillion won ($75.4 billion) this year, comprising cash dividends of 30 trillion won and share repurchases and cancellations of 60 trillion won, including 40 trillion won announced in August. items.author: Suh Jong-gap, Cho Yang-joon, Lee Seok-jin
items.highlights: Nvidia posted another record quarter as the leader in artificial intelligence chips, prompting analysts to raise their earnings expectations for Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. Expanding investment in AI data centers and a prolonged shortage of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) are expected to sustain profit gains at the South Korean memory makers for some time.
